items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1971-04-08
items.q: And, uh, they grabbed, uh... Elizabeth.

ctx.x: What's one song of yours that was grabbed? For example. Hmm? What are some of the songs of yours that were grabbed?
Well, they grabbed, uh... I was mistreated. And they grabbed, uh... Elizabeth. And, uh, they grabbed Isabella. When I come to find out, they was playing, you know. What do you mean?
Did you say anything ever to anybody?
